messages:
Nina (Product): short sync on Dedicated roadmap: choosing between credit-bucket vs fixed min-share for reserved pools. goal: predictable tail for premium tenants during noisy neighbor events + reasonable pilot complexity.

Diego (Eng-Platform): credit-buckets give headroom for bursty tenants and are easier to tune per-tenant. fixed min-share is straightforward but wastes capacity for bursty patterns.

Rina (SRE): operationally we want bounded failure modes. credit-buckets risk slow starvation unless replenish rules are sane. propose guaranteed_min + credit_buckets (hybrid).

Liu (Eng-ML): perf angle: spilling requests across regions or to a variant has cold-cache risk. if we allow frequent spill, ensure per-tenant KV partitioning or prefetch on spill.

Clara (Customer Success): pilot customers (one gaming, one fintech) want strong tail promises for premium lanes. fintech requires regional preference and detailed spill audit CSV.

Nina (Product): suggested pilot policy: a small guaranteed_min (minutes of tokens) + bucket that refills based on moving-average of baseline RPS. plus max_spill_rate to avoid cascades.

Diego (Eng-Platform): draft policy snippet: 
spill_policy: hybrid
  guaranteed_min_tokens: 3000
  replenish_window_s: 600
  max_spill_rate_per_tenant: 25rps
  preempt_on: region_occupancy>0.9

Rina (SRE): safety gates to require before rollout:
- p95 for premium tenants <= 150ms for 48h under mixed load
- no more than 2% duplicate or double-billing artifacts in sims
- cost delta at cluster <= 1.4x baseline
- audit CSV available every 30m to CS

Liu (Eng-ML): action: prototype per-tenant KV shard + an API hook for prefetch-on-spill. ETA 10 days.

Diego (Eng-Platform): action: implement hybrid admission (guaranteed_min + bucket) + max_spill_rate in staging. need product-provided policy API shape. ETA 2w.

Rina (SRE): action: create canary sims: (A) high-priority spike 60s, (B) region A partial outage 20m, (C) cold-cache +50% miss. add billing-reconcile check. ETA 1w.

Clara (Customer Success): action: get pilot customer sign-off on audit CSV format and regional-preference rules.

CI-Bot: scheduled sim job "hybrid-spill-2025-02-12" queued.

Nina (Product): product decision: run hybrid policy for pilot, operator-triggered variant fallback for first 2 weeks, then consider automatic fallback. launch checklist items: runbook, sims, routing PR, CSV sample, cost estimate.

Diego (Eng-Platform): question: do we allow per-tenant overrides for max_spill_rate? recommended yes but default conservative.

Nina (Product): yes allow per-tenant override but require review and billing guardrails.

Rina (SRE): add metric "silent_spill_detect" (requests rerouted without latency increase) to detect billing drift.

Liu (Eng-ML): noted. prototype will include latency delta and kv_miss_rate in the trigger metrics.

Nina (Product): next sync Friday 11am PT. deliverables: staging PR, sim results, runbook draft, customer signoffs. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
